registration: Before new parent-source bodies, child messages or patches are read. Continue beyond metadata in the same turn following the user's latest instruction.
purpose: Establish actual common consumer, architecture provider, applicable contract and same-mechanism eligibility; parent-only model proposals precede repair review. Not a declared blind detection benchmark.

collection.initial: Read only registered complete files at exact parent, retain failures and byte identity.
collection.supplement: Per case at most one bounded direct-symbol location search, then at most two provider implementation paths and one configuration file; at most eight complete files total. Document why chosen before reading supplement bodies. No recursive helper/header expansion.
collection.exposure: Compare the D parent regions with previously read arch_topology material. Hash not found does not prove source or repair-family independence; whole-file and function overlap are recorded explicitly.
collection.adequacy: Before model request, inventory provider/consumer/object/conditions/deadline and list opaque boundaries. Missing essential material means insufficient qualification; do not use a model to invent the missing implementation or count it as a detection miss.

model.delivery: Nonempty final, matching returned model, exit0 and only normal observed stop reasons. Any refusal is incomplete; no reformulation to recover refused content.
model.billing: Visible client counters and conservative reservation separate; internal recovery and actual billing can remain unknown.
model.input: Same exact-parent documents and disclosed research purpose; no child title, diff, message or old screening answer. File/function selection is researcher input, not automatic discovery.
model.output: Readable evidence-cited analysis, at most three concrete contract candidates, with provider, consumer, scope/object, conditions, first content use and authority gaps. No fragile formatting-only retry or automatic semantic adoption.

review.ordering: Save parent model delivery/failure and original proposal before a separate oracle role reads the selected child message/patch.
review.oracle_scope: Only two selected commits and existing case/family records. Keep post-repair knowledge separate from parent proposals. No new source files beyond bounded collection.
review.positive: Requires architecture-derived condition, common purpose/consumer, supported violated requirement and reason for differential exposure.
review.normal: Requires same-use legal applicable path and evidence of satisfaction, not title or absence of a report.
review.first_use: A real scope/range error may be useful to the broader direction but is not forced into first-use readiness.
review.components: Do not change frozen method. Only if a concrete adequately sourced first-use candidate exists, assess applicable existing evidence obligations; unsupported or unproved inputs stay insufficient. No repeated generic parser failure demonstration is required.
review.independence: Prior screening, manual selection, whole-file/source overlap and same-family exposure remain disclosed. Source qualification is not by itself independent automatic detection.

exit: Complete bounded parent/source and model/oracle review, classify scope and concrete requirement, identify one next substantive N1/N2 action; update same-day log and Windows/WSL current checkpoint.
